thread:
Priya Nair: FYI noticed a ~20% bump in reconciliation work last night — lots of events landing in the 'fallback' ingestion path and then being reprocessed by the reconcile job. wondering whether this is a contract drift or just watermark timing. :thinking:
Sam Lee: Can you paste an example event id? is it the 'usage_event.v2' shape or the old shape?
Priya Nair: example id: ev_20260321_9a7f. It has usage_event.v2 but missing attribution.fingerprint. We think it timed out before tokenproofing callback returned, so it routed to fallback which emits a sparse credit.
Michael Chen: If tokenproofing times out we currently emit a provisional credit with tenant_id + approximate_cost and mark provenance=partial. That gets compacted and makes the final reconcile do more work to repair. Tradeoff was throughput vs correctness.
Aria Gomez: Right — fallback intentionally keeps latency low for runtime callers but the long tail is heavy on the reconcile pass. Two quick options: 1) increase tokenproofing timeout (slower p95 for callers) or 2) make fallback emit a light provenance pointer so finalizer can reattach without a heavy repair.
Sam Lee: I lean toward #2. We could emit a 'provenance_handle' that is just a deterministic fingerprint and a tombstone timestamp. Finalizer can then fetch the full envelope asynchronously and avoid an expensive scan.
Priya Nair: Implementation sketch I had in mind: on fallback path we write a small record to the 'fallback_prov' topic: {fingerprint, src_time, provisional_cost, origin}. Finalizer joins on fingerprint during reconcile and upgrades the provisional credit. That keeps runtime fast.
Michael Chen: Two caveats: 1) fingerprint collisions — need namespace + tenant salt, 2) ordering — the fallback_prov write may arrive after the full usage payload. Finalizer must tolerate out-of-order by using idempotent upsert semantics.
Aria Gomez: Agree on salted fingerprint. For ordering we can rely on the finalizer's watermark window + a grace_delay config (default 10m) then perform a two-pass reconcile: fast pass for obvious matches, slow pass for late bindings.
Priya Nair: deploy-bot: reconcile-run started for window 2026-03-21T00:00..2026-03-21T06:00
deploy-bot: reconcile-run finished (duration 3m, repaired 128 provisional credits)
Sam Lee: Operational note — add metrics for provisional->finalized ratio and time-to-finalize histogram. If >95th pct exceeds N minutes we can auto-tune grace_delay.
Michael Chen: Also update the ingest contract: producers must include tenant_salt header when available. Fallback path will fallback to global salt but that should be opt-in via config.
Aria Gomez: I'll open a tiny RFC describing the provenance_handle and the two-pass finalizer. Will include proto changes and migration steps (backfill strategy for existing provisional rows).
Priya Nair: Thanks. Action items: Aria RFC + migration, Sam adds metrics and grace_delay autotune, Michael prototype fallback_prov schema and idempotent upsert. I'll run a backfill probe this afternoon. :thumbsup:
